test_title: Delhi Police Constable (Executive) 2023 - Reasoning (Held on: 02 Dec, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
Which figure should replace the question mark (?) if the following series were to be continued?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4cf7aadecb67e0807845c6f116a8fd2fe3d5ae13ff0b249b52b055fb9f2ab3a2.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is:

**From figure 1 to 2 and figure 3 to 4:**

All 3 bottom symbols are interchanging their position.

Top-left symbol shifts in middle surface and middle surface symbol shifts in middle position, middle shifts in middle-right position and middle-right symbol shifts in top-left corner position.

Top-right corner symbol interchange its position with left-middle position symbol.

**From figure 2 to 3 and figure 4 to 5:**

All 3 top symbols are interchanging their position.

Bottom and middle all 6 symbols are interchanging their position

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e779c014823a05a34e79de6c22d373e9b990e58151bea7b972496b0f088f90f5.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".
